quarterly_data.quarter: Eli Lilly press release: Lilly's oral GLP-1, Foundayo (orforglipron), was associated (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: In post-hoc, model-based analyses of the Phase 3 ATTAIN-1 trial in adults with obesity or overweight with a weight-related medical problem (published in Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism), Foundayo 5.5 mg, 9 mg and 17.2 mg were associated at 72 weeks with an estimated 45.0%, 50.0% and 57.0% reduction in predicted 10-year type 2 diabetes risk versus placebo (HR = 0.55, 0.50 and 0.43), and the 17.2 mg dose with an estimated 18.0% reduction in predicted cardiovascular disease risk (HR = 0.82). Thomas Seck (SVP product development, Lilly Cardiometabolic Health) said the analyses, together with evidence that treating obesity lowers healthcare costs, give 'real optimism about what long-term Foundayo use could mean' for patients and the healthcare system.
